method: Independently collect public GitHub history and solve a full-history repository collaboration network with the OpenRank equation. No externally published scores are used.

automationExclusion.scope: Remove identified Bot/AI/service actors and their activities before graph construction. Remove automation-only work items without eligible participants. No broad substring matches; remaining accounts are not claimed to be verified humans.

parameters.time: One graph containing all collected history through capture; no monthly cutoff, monthly decay, or sum of precomputed scores.
adaptations: Full-history graph rather than monthly inheritance.
Direct commits not represented in PRs become base-1 work items; coauthor credit is split.
Unlinked code contributors use a single verified GitHub contributor-summary work item, without inventing event dates.
Public comments whose parent is unavailable connect to a neutral base-1 item; missing author/status is not inferred.
No reaction bonus or inaccessible/deleted/private activity is inferred.
